description: A touring show producer must approve the binding load-in plan for a one-night arena performance, including the scenic configuration, unloading method, labor call, and crew commitments.

shared_context.S1: The touring show is booked for a one-night performance at Harbor Arena this Saturday.
shared_context.S2: The current draft plan uses a single-piece scenic arch, unloads from the arena dock, and calls for a general stagehand crew.
shared_context.S3: Mara must approve the final load-in plan before trucking instructions and crew calls are issued.
shared_context.S4: As part of the arena's standard pre-event approval, Mara conducts a final check-in with venue technical management and production management before locking the plan.

PF1.text: Dev received the arena's certified access measurements from facilities this morning: the dock door is 2.4 meters wide, and the single-piece scenic arch crate is 2.6 meters wide; the arch must therefore be transported as a sectional arch and brought through the ground-level dock rather than the freight elevator. The certificate arrived after the draft load-in plan was circulated, so Dev has not yet added it to the production file.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed with the arena labor steward this afternoon that the labor agreement requires exactly six arena stagehands, with a call from 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and prohibits the touring crew from self-unloading the trucks; she has not logged the confirmation because the steward returned it after the daily production meeting.

acceptance_conditions: The scenic arch must be configured as sectional.
The scenic equipment must be unloaded through the ground-level dock.
Exactly six arena stagehands must be assigned.
The labor call must run from 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
The touring crew must not self-unload the trucks.
The labor restrictions must be reflected in the final plan, including the prohibition on touring crew self-unloading.

content_checks.C6: decisions['touring_crew_self_unloads'] == False or any(c.get('type') in ['documentation', 'plan_revision', 'crew_call_update', 'document_update', 'labor_compliance'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The certified 2.4-meter dock width versus the 2.6-meter single-piece crate changes the scenic configuration to a sectional arch and requires ground-level dock access.
The labor steward's confirmation changes the crew plan to exactly six arena stagehands from 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM and changes touring_crew_self_unloads from true or unspecified to false.
